package.description: Your prompt vocabulary, one hotkey away, in every window

en-US.author: Alpaslan Bek
en-US.description: Your prompt vocabulary, one hotkey away, in every window
en-US.longDescription: A tray app for Windows that keeps your prompt library one hotkey away. Press the hotkey in any window, pick a prompt, and it is pasted where you were, with the clipboard already substituted for {clipboard}. Prompts live as plain JSON under %APPDATA%; packs are files you can share or let an agent write. No telemetry. One update check, off in a click.
en-US.name: Promptline
en-US.releaseNotes:
Generate gives a coding agent a file of its own, so its work can't be overwritten and the dialog waits until the agent has really written something. Builds on v0.2.28.
Generate
- An agent writes to its own file. Every coding-agent run now makes a scratch file under packs\generated\. A topic naming a pack you already have starts as a copy of that pack, whatever the case you typed, and the agent is asked for new prompts only, since an import adds to the pack.
- The review opens when the agent has written something. Naming an existing pack used to open it within seconds, showing the pack's own prompts as if the agent had finished.
- Closing the dialog tells you where the file is. The notice names it, says how to import it, and has a Show file button. Copy again keeps the same file, so an agent that already has the instruction writes where the dialog is watching.
Pack files
- A pack's file is the app's output. Promptline rewrites it on the next save, so an edit made in it is lost. That was already so, but the README and a tooltip suggested an agent could write there, and they no longer do. If you edit pack files by hand, bring the changes in through Settings → Backup and import → Import… → From file….
Install
Promptline_0.2.29_x64-setup.exe (NSIS) or Promptline_0.2.29_x64_en-US.msi.
Signed, so Windows names the publisher. SmartScreen can still warn while a
new release builds its reputation: More info → Run anyway.
Your prompts, packs and settings carry over untouched.
